title: Longitudinal federated learning sample unbalanced processing method based on OT protocol

pse.problem: The method addresses the problem of unbalanced sample distribution in vertical federated learning, where the difference between positive and negative samples is more than 100 times. This leads to poor model fitting and insufficient learning when using a general federated learning model.
pse.solution_function: The OT protocol-based method performs secure, privacy-preserving processing of imbalanced vertical federated learning samples by utilizing an OT protocol. The method sorts the aligned samples in ascending order according to id and normalizes the features for distance calculation. It then balances the distribution of positive and negative samples during training by controlling false positive rate (fp) using a threshold.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include parties involved in federated learning, sorting algorithm, feature normalization method, OT protocol, and classification threshold.
pse.solution_implementation: Each party sorts their samples according to the alignment id. The features are then normalized for distance calculation. An OT protocol ensures secure communication between parties while balancing the sample distribution during training by controlling the false positive rate using a threshold in a cascade boosting approach.
pse.effect: The method results in improved model fitting and better learning of positive samples due to balanced sample distribution, ensuring privacy and security through the use of multi-party secure computing technology.
